scope: QC SHA-256 baseline comparison for unchanged registry assets; independent current hash and approval checks for all eleven promoted LOD0 entries. No asset files modified.
method: Flatten registry entries using pipeline-lib.mjs indexEntries semantics, excluding the current runtime compatibility allowlist from strict QC mismatch checks.
